title: German ATS Analysis
subtitle: Live validation for German HR & ATS (2026)
professionalDesc: Full-time roles — business impact, leadership, production systems.
werkstudentDesc: Student jobs — projects, visa, availability, GitHub portfolio.

verdict.excellent: Excellent — ready for German recruiters & ATS.
verdict.excellentWerkstudent: Strong Werkstudent profile for German startups.
verdict.good: Good foundation — a few improvements recommended.
verdict.needsWork: Needs improvement before applying in Germany.
verdict.critical: Critical gaps — address missing sections first.

tips.useActionVerbs: Start bullets with strong action verbs (Built, Implemented, Optimized).
tips.addMetrics: Add metrics: %, user counts, latency, revenue impact.
tips.keepOneColumn: Use single-column ATS-safe layout (German Lebenslauf standard).
tips.pdfExport: Export as PDF with standard fonts (Inter, Arial, Calibri).

header.nameSuggest: Add first and last name prominently at the top.
header.headlineSuggest: Add target role e.g. Full Stack MERN Developer.
header.phoneSuggest: German recruiters expect a reachable phone number.
header.locationSuggest: Add city and country (e.g. Berlin, Germany).
header.linkedinSuggest: Add LinkedIn — checked in the first 8 seconds.
header.githubSuggest: Add GitHub — essential for developers in Germany.
header.portfolioSuggest: Add portfolio or live project URL.

summary.tooShortSuggest: Write 3–4 lines: years, stack, specialization, goal.
summary.tooLongSuggest: Keep summary under 600 characters — German HR prefers concise.
summary.yearsSuggest: State experience e.g. 4+ years or student level.
summary.techSuggest: Mention React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, etc.
summary.genericSuggest: Replace clichés with technical facts and results.

skills.atsSuggest: Include React, Node, TypeScript, Docker, AWS, PostgreSQL.

experience.countSuggest: Add at least one role or strong internship.
experience.werkstudentWarn: Add internship or working student role if possible
experience.werkstudentSuggest: Even part-time tech roles strengthen Werkstudent CVs.
experience.verbsSuggest: Start with Built, Implemented, Optimized, Led.
experience.structureSuggest: Each role needs company, title, dates, bullets.

projects.stackSuggest: Add React, Node, DB stack under each project.

languages.countSuggest: Add German and English with CEFR levels.

werkstudent.visaSuggest: e.g. Student residence permit — eligible for Werkstudent.
werkstudent.taxSuggest: German employers expect Steuer-ID for payroll.
werkstudent.socialSecuritySuggest: Provide your Sozialversicherungsnummer for German payroll.

format.templateSuggest: Use German ATS Professional or Minimal template.
